title: Density at least one on the support from an almost-everywhere bound and upper semicontinuity
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (Θ : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.massOn W = μ W) → (∀ x ∈ T.support, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball x ε) ≠ 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ θ : ℝ, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal θ)) → 1 ≤ θ) → (∀ y ∈ U, HasMassDensity T y (Θ y)) → UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U → ∀ y ∈ T.support, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity T y θ → 1 ≤ θ
